headline: Prompt Engineering is dead. Context Engineering won.
narration: Clever one-line prompts do not fix failing agents. Context engineering is designing the exact system of info the model sees at every step.
terminal: "Act as a senior dev and fix it."

headline: Write, Select, Compress, and Isolate
narration: Great agent builders use four levers: write memory to files, select only relevant snippets, compress long logs, and isolate sub-tasks.

headline: More tokens in context makes models dumber
narration: Dumping an entire codebase into the window causes context rot. Keep only high-signal lines in view and your accuracy jumps.

headline: Next: Harness Engineering
narration: Save this cheat sheet and follow DababonPro for part five on Harness Engineering.
